inputs_sent.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same room, the same camera position and framing, the same light, the lit phone on the bedside table, and the same man asleep in the bed under the duvet, who has not moved. Add one new element: a double of the sleeping man, made of light, sits on the near edge of the bed beside the sleeper's waist, with his bare feet on the floor, seen from the side, leaning toward the head of the bed. With one hand he holds the top edge of the duvet at the sleeper's shoulder: he has just gently pulled it up to cover him. The double is an exact copy of the man shown in image 2 and image 3, who is also the man asleep in the bed: the same face, the same short dark hair and trimmed beard, the same warm medium-brown skin, the same dark charcoal T-shirt and the same loose dark grey pyjama trousers. His face and skin keep their own natural brown colour and his clothes keep their own dark colours; only the light itself is pale mint-green (#b7f4cf). He is lit from within: a soft core of mint light glows inside his chest and shines out through his body, which has soft edges and no hard drawn outline. He is now almost solid, only faintly see-through at the legs. A few hair-thin threads of mint light, as fine as spun glass, still join his chest to the sleeper's chest, with tiny beads of light on them. He looks down at the sleeper's face with a calm, kind expression and closed lips; he does not look at the camera. His glow falls softly on the duvet, the pillow, the sleeper's face and the floorboards at his feet. He looks friendly, gentle and capable, never ghostly or frightening. There are exactly two figures in the room: one solid and asleep in the bed, one made of light. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.
